The CO(3-2) channel maps (Fig. [\[channelmapCO\]](#channelmapCO)) show a possible rotation of molecular gas (also seen in the RGB composite image in Fig. [\[rgbCO\]](#rgbCO)), perpendicular to the ionization cone axis, and evidence of blueshifted outflows
This structure comes towards the nucleus with redshifted velocities at south and low velocities closer to the nucleus, as seen in the CO(3-2) RGB. That suggests a feeding process of the nucleus.
